live.instructions:
Read-only documentation for the ADITUS event-technology APIs (ticketing, registration, access, accreditation, Business Intelligence) and the Shop Micro Frontend.
Start with search_docs for a topic, list_modules for orientation, then get_endpoint for the full contract (parameters, body, example responses) or get_guide for integration guides.
Shop Micro Frontend: 'micro-frontend' is the compact contract for coding agents, 'micro-frontend-docs' the complete human documentation, 'micro-frontend-overview' the non-technical overview (what it is, purchase flow, base setup, add-on levels) for questions from non-developers.
API hosts are per customer: request examples use the {{API_BASE_URL}} placeholder; never invent a hostname.
ADITUS also offers an MCP server over the ADITUS API itself (a customer's own event data). That server is NOT this one: it requires an API client for the customer system; customers arrange it with their ADITUS Customer Success Manager. This documentation server is public, read-only and needs no credentials.

tools.name: search_docs
tools.title: Search ADITUS documentation
tools.description: Full-text search across API modules, endpoints (name, path, description) and the guides (Shop Micro Frontend agent contract, full documentation and overview; Guidelines; Webhooks). The reference is English; German search terms are understood as well (a generated language layer maps them onto the English vocabulary, e.g. 'aussteller' → exhibitor, 'gutschein' → voucher). Returns ranked hits with ids usable in get_endpoint / get_guide.

query.description: Search terms in English or German, e.g. 'create cart', 'webhook signature', 'timeslot', 'session token', 'aussteller import'

tools.name: list_modules
tools.title: List API modules
tools.description: All top-level ADITUS API modules with direction (inbound = your systems call ADITUS, outbound = ADITUS data into your systems), endpoint counts and documentation URLs. Also lists the integration guides.

tools.name: list_endpoints
tools.title: List endpoints of a module
tools.description: Every endpoint of one module (id, method, path, sub-group, one-line summary). Use the module id from list_modules.

tools.name: get_endpoint
tools.title: Get endpoint details
tools.description: Full contract of one endpoint: method, URL, auth, query and header parameters, request body example, example responses (large bodies truncated, full text on the docs page). Accepts the endpoint id from search/list, or 'METHOD /path'. Path parameters may use any name or spelling (':cart', '{cartId}', a concrete value); a leading '/api' or '/v1' is ignored. Some routes are recorded several times with different query parameters: a reference without query string resolves to the recording without query parameters, a reference with a query string (e.g. '?$expand=All') to the recording with exactly (or at least) those keys. If that still leaves several recordings, the result is { ambiguous: true, candidates: [{ id, name, method, path }] } instead of the contract — call again with one of the candidate ids. When nothing matches, the error lists the nearest endpoints of that method.

tools.name: get_guide
tools.title: Get an integration guide
tools.description: Markdown of an integration guide. 'micro-frontend' is the compact Shop Micro Frontend contract for coding agents (mounting, sessions, styling, Web Component, lifecycle, security); 'micro-frontend-docs' is the complete Micro Frontend documentation as on the website; 'micro-frontend-overview' is the non-technical overview (what it is, purchase flow, base setup, add-on levels); module guides such as 'guidelines' or 'webhooks' come from the API reference. Pass a section heading to fetch only that section.

section.description: Optional section heading (or slug) to return only that part
